question: In the final of the ICC Under-19 Men's Cricket World Cup 2026, India defeated which team by 100 runs?
solution:
The correct answer is __**England by 100 runs.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• India defeated England by 100 runs in the ICC Under-19 Men’s Cricket World Cup 2026 final.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Opposition**: England U-19 national team.
 
• **Margin**: 100 runs—the largest in U-19 World Cup final history.
 
• **Date**: February 6, 2026.
 
• **Venue**: Harare Sports Club, Zimbabwe.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• Run Margin__: Difference in runs when the side batting second is all out or the overs finish.
 
• __Final Match__: Concluding fixture that decides the tournament champion.
 
• __England U-19__: Under-19 cricket team representing England and Wales Cricket Board.
 
• __India U-19__: Under-19 cricket team representing Board of Control for Cricket in India.
